description: Counter Strike Lite (CS Lite) delivers the nostalgic Counter-Strike style gaming experience on your windows 8 and tablet! Enjoy the smooth touch controls and play the exciting cross-platform 2D shooter against computer on other all platforms. Counter Strike Lite’s awesome features include: - Player vs. Bots - Smooth and responsive touch controls - unique maps - Different Guns - Many levels *Note: This game is not a 3D FPS counter strike game, But you will enjoy the game. * Review & Rate us now. -------------------------------------------------- PLEASE RATE AND REVIEW: ----------------------...
